verdict.rationale: The evidence pack contains no mention of checkpointing, run resurrection, or resuming a crashed crawl from saved state; it only covers general Actor execution, webhooks on run failure, and client retries, none of which address resuming a crashed deep crawl. missing for 10: documentation of checkpoint/state persistence for crawls, evidence of 'resurrect run' or resume-from-request-queue functionality, and any independent confirmation of successful crash recovery.
